inlines.v: FABRICATION, noun 1. The act of framing or constructing construction; as the fabrication of a bridge or of a church. 2. The act of manufacturing. 3. The act of devising falsely; forgery. 4. That which is fabricated; a falsehood. The story is doubtless a fabrication
